components.currentBehavior: Injects GITHUB_TOKEN, GIT_USER_NAME, GIT_USER_EMAIL from devbob-secrets K8s Secret into container environment
components.desiredBehavior: Should inject valid GitHub PAT (classic) token to enable gh CLI authentication
components.gap: GITHUB_TOKEN value is placeholder 'none' instead of valid token (ghp_*)

components.currentBehavior: Configures git user.name and user.email from env vars. Attempts gh auth login with GITHUB_TOKEN. Uses '|| true' to suppress errors.
components.desiredBehavior: Should validate GITHUB_TOKEN format before attempting authentication. Should fail fast or set feature flag if authentication fails.
components.gap: Silent failure on invalid token leads to runtime PR creation failures. No validation of token format (accepts 'none').

components.currentBehavior: Pushes branch to remote, checks if gh CLI is installed, calls 'gh pr create' to create PR. Throws error if gh CLI not installed.
components.desiredBehavior: Should validate gh CLI is AUTHENTICATED before attempting PR creation, not just installed.
components.gap: Missing authentication check. Only checks 'gh --version' (line 302), not 'gh auth status'. Fails at runtime with HTTP 401 error.

components.currentBehavior: Installs git (version 2.39.5) and GitHub CLI (gh). Verified in deployment logs.
components.desiredBehavior: Should have git and gh CLI installed and accessible in PATH.

components.currentBehavior: Defines githubToken, gitUserName, gitUserEmail in secrets section. Default values provided.
components.desiredBehavior: Should require non-empty githubToken with format validation.
components.gap: No validation that githubToken is not placeholder. Accepts empty or 'none' values.

gap.summary: Single point of failure: GITHUB_TOKEN value is placeholder 'none' instead of valid GitHub PAT
impactChain: Step 1: Invalid token injected into environment
Step 2: gh auth login fails but error suppressed with '|| true'
Step 2-6: All other operations succeed (misleading success)
Step 7: gh pr create fails with HTTP 401 at runtime
gap.fixRequired: Replace GITHUB_TOKEN value in devbob-secrets with valid GitHub PAT (classic) with repo, workflow scopes
